prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: It was me who telephoned (A) / the emergency helpline number (B) / when the fire broke out in the building. (C) / No Error (D)
options: when the fire broke out in the building.
explanation: After the linking verb 'was' in an 'It was ... who' structure, the complement takes the nominative case. Correct: 'It was I who telephoned'.
